sentences.text: The documents do not state a late payment fee for credit card dues.
The only credit-card-specific item shown is a CHARGES table heading for Credit Cards, but it does not give a fee amount or fee formula.
The policy text on delayed payment says charges, if any, for delayed payment shall be applied on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount, but it does not set a credit card dues fee.
